standing.general: Hinge at hips, soft knees, chest at 45 degrees, neutral spine.
standing.ballContact: Pound the ball down; do not slap with loose fingers.

seated.general: Sit on the front edge of a chair, tall neutral spine, zero back load.
seated.ballContact: Pure wrist and forearm snap; isolate arm mechanics.

drills.name: Fingertip Ball Taps
drills.description: Don't look at the ball. Keep a tight stance, and ensure your movements are explosive. V-crosses should be smaller than 1 meter.
